PROPERTY DESCRIPTION
OUE Bayfront comprises:
•  OUE Bayfront, an 18-storey  
Grade A office building;
•  OUE Tower, a conserved tower 
building with panoramic views 
of the Marina Bay landscape 
currently occupied by a fine 
dining restaurant; and
•  OUE Link, an overhead pedestrian 
link bridge with retail units
